Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.

petitioner. 
Mr. Pankaj Chaturvedi, Standing 
Counsel for the Union of India. 
Misc. application (IA 12442 of 2020) is 
allowed. Counter affidavit is taken on record. 
As prayed, two weeks’ time is granted to 
learned counsel for the petitioner to file 
rejoinder affidavit. 
List thereafter alongwith connected 
petition. 
No ground to grant interim relief to the 
petitioner is made out at this stage. Interim 
relief application (CLMA 6962 of 2019) is, 
therefore, dismissed.
